lists.name: Fixtures
lists.orderingRule: Morning routine: relieve → wash → check appearance → bathe → dry → medicate/groom

mnemonic.phrase: Tinkle, Suds Up, Mirror Check, Steamy Shower, Towel Off, Medicine Time.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Tinkle → Toilet (bathroom use); Suds Up → Sink (washing hands/face); Mirror Check → Mirror; Steamy Shower → Shower; Towel Off → Towel Rack; Medicine Time → Medicine Cabinet (last step before leaving).

lists.name: Laundry Stations
lists.orderingRule: Laundry lifecycle: collect → treat → wash → dry → press → fold → store

mnemonic.phrase: Heap it, Douse it, Wash it, Dry it, Iron it, Fold it, Lock it away.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Each verb names the action performed at that piece, doubling as its first letter: Heap → Hamper; Douse → Detergent Shelf; Wash → Washer; Dry → Dryer; Iron → Ironing Board; Fold → Folding Table; Lock away → Linen Closet.

lists.name: Arrival Stations
lists.orderingRule: Arrival/departure routine: enter → shed outerwear → sit to remove shoes → store footwear → stow umbrella → drop keys/mail → check appearance

mnemonic.phrase: Fling Open, Coat Off, Bench Down, Shoes Off, Umbrella Up, Console Keys, Mirror Check.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Fling Open → Front Door; Coat Off → Coat Rack; Bench Down → Bench (sit to remove shoes); Shoes Off → Shoe Rack; Umbrella Up → Umbrella Stand; Console Keys → Console Table (drop keys/mail); Mirror Check → Mirror (last look before leaving).

lists.name: Bedtime Furniture
lists.orderingRule: Evening routine: undress → put away/retrieve sleepwear → check appearance → lie down → bedside items → set alarm → lights out

mnemonic.phrase: Closet Open, Dresser Drawer, Mirror Glance, Bed Sinks, Nightstand Glasses, Alarm Set, Lamp Off.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Closet Open → Closet; Dresser Drawer → Dresser; Mirror Glance → Mirror; Bed Sinks → Bed; Nightstand Glasses → Nightstand; Alarm Set → Alarm Clock; Lamp Off → Lamp (last thing touched before sleep).

lists.name: Work Furniture
lists.orderingRule: Work session: sit → set up → view screen → produce output → consult reference → archive

mnemonic.phrase: Chair Pulled, Desk Cleared, Monitor Glows, Printer Hums, Bookshelf Checked, Filed Away.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Chair Pulled → Chair; Desk Cleared → Desk; Monitor Glows → Monitor; Printer Hums → Printer; Bookshelf Checked → Bookshelf (reference); Filed Away → Filing Cabinet (last step, archiving).

lists.name: Seating & Focal Points
lists.orderingRule: Spatial center-out: foundation → primary seating → central surface → focal point → secondary seating → ambiance → reference

mnemonic.phrase: Rug Underfoot, Sofa Sinks, Coffee Steams, TV Glows, Armchair Creaks, Fireplace Crackles, Bookshelf Waits.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Rug Underfoot → Rug (foundation); Sofa Sinks → Sofa; Coffee Steams → Coffee Table; TV Glows → TV Stand; Armchair Creaks → Armchair; Fireplace Crackles → Fireplace; Bookshelf Waits → Bookshelf.

lists.name: Dinner-Party Furniture
lists.orderingRule: Meal-service flow: set table → seat guests → light table → light room → serve → pour → store fine china

mnemonic.phrase: Table Set, Chairs Pulled, Candles Lit, Chandelier Glows, Sideboard Serves, Wine Poured, China Stored.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Table Set → Table; Chairs Pulled → Chairs; Candles Lit → Candles; Chandelier Glows → Chandelier; Sideboard Serves → Sideboard; Wine Poured → Wine Rack; China Stored → China Cabinet (put away after).

lists.name: Workout Stations
lists.orderingRule: Workout structure: warm up → cardio → strength → support → cool down → check form → hydrate

mnemonic.phrase: Jump First, Treadmill Next, Weights Lifted, Bench Pressed, Yoga Stretched, Mirror Checked, Water Last.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Jump First → Jump Rope (warm-up); Treadmill Next → Treadmill (cardio); Weights Lifted → Weight Rack; Bench Pressed → Bench; Yoga Stretched → Yoga Mat (cool-down); Mirror Checked → Mirror (form check); Water Last → Water Bottle Station (hydrate, done).

lists.name: Baby-Care Furniture
lists.orderingRule: Baby-care routine: sleep → stimulate → change → dispose → soothe → play → wind down

mnemonic.phrase: Crib Wakes, Mobile Spins, Changing Time, Diaper Tossed, Rocking Soothes, Toys Out, Books Read.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Crib Wakes → Crib; Mobile Spins → Mobile; Changing Time → Changing Table; Diaper Tossed → Diaper Pail; Rocking Soothes → Rocking Chair; Toys Out → Toy Chest; Books Read → Bookshelf (last, quiet wind-down).

lists.name: Workshop Furniture
lists.orderingRule: Project workflow: park → build → hang tools → store tools → shelve supplies → store transport → dispose

mnemonic.phrase: Car Parked, Workbench Cleared, Pegboard Hung, Toolbox Opened, Shelving Stacked, Bikes Racked, Recycling Out.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Car Parked → Car; Workbench Cleared → Workbench; Pegboard Hung → Pegboard; Toolbox Opened → Tool Chest; Shelving Stacked → Shelving; Bikes Racked → Bike Rack; Recycling Out → Recycling Bin (last, taken to the curb).

mnemonic.phrase: Mini Mover, More Munching, Curious Climber, Mighty Muncher, Bold Barker, Chest Thumper, Gentle Giant.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Mini Mover → Mouse Lemur (smallest, quickest); More Munching → Marmoset; Curious Climber → Capuchin; Mighty Muncher → Macaque; Bold Barker → Baboon; Chest Thumper → Chimpanzee; Gentle Giant → Gorilla (largest primate, despite the gentle nickname).

mnemonic.phrase: Keen Kestrel, Fast Falcon, Hovering Hawk, Old Owl, Elegant Eagle, Circling Condor.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Keen Kestrel → Kestrel (smallest, keenest hunter); Fast Falcon → Falcon (fastest diver); Hovering Hawk → Hawk; Old Owl → Owl; Elegant Eagle → Eagle; Circling Condor → Condor (largest, soars on thermals).

mnemonic.phrase: Garden Slither, Cornfield Crawl, Rattling Warning, Cobra Rises, Boa Squeezes, Python Coils, Anaconda Swallows.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Garden Slither → Garter Snake; Cornfield Crawl → Corn Snake; Rattling Warning → Rattlesnake; Cobra Rises → Cobra; Boa Squeezes → Boa Constrictor; Python Coils → Python; Anaconda Swallows → Anaconda (longest/heaviest, ends the list).

mnemonic.phrase: Ocelot Prowls, Cheetah Sprints, Leopard Climbs, Jaguar Swims, Cougar Leaps, Lion Roars, Tiger Rules.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Ocelot Prowls → Ocelot (smallest); Cheetah Sprints → Cheetah (fastest); Leopard Climbs → Leopard; Jaguar Swims → Jaguar; Cougar Leaps → Cougar; Lion Roars → Lion; Tiger Rules → Tiger (largest big cat).

mnemonic.phrase: Meerkats Watch, Warthogs Wallow, Zebras Wander, Wildebeest Migrate, Rhinos Graze, Giraffes Reach, Elephants Rule.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Meerkats Watch → Meerkat (smallest, always alert); Warthogs Wallow → Warthog; Zebras Wander → Zebra; Wildebeest Migrate → Wildebeest; Rhinos Graze → Rhino; Giraffes Reach → Giraffe (tallest); Elephants Rule → Elephant (largest land animal).

lists.name: Marine Life
lists.orderingRule: Habitat depth, shallow reef to deep sea

mnemonic.phrase: Clownfish Dart, Sea Turtles Glide, Octopus Hides, Stingrays Skim, Sharks Patrol, Jellyfish Drift, Anglerfish Lurk.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Clownfish Dart → Clownfish (shallow reef); Sea Turtles Glide → Sea Turtle; Octopus Hides → Octopus; Stingrays Skim → Stingray; Sharks Patrol → Shark; Jellyfish Drift → Jellyfish; Anglerfish Lurk → Anglerfish (deep sea, ends the descent).

mnemonic.phrase: Arctic Fox Trots, Snowy Owl Watches, Penguins Waddle, Seals Slide, Walruses Wallow, Polar Bears Prowl, Belugas Sing.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Arctic Fox Trots → Arctic Fox; Snowy Owl Watches → Snowy Owl; Penguins Waddle → Penguin; Seals Slide → Seal; Walruses Wallow → Walrus; Polar Bears Prowl → Polar Bear; Belugas Sing → Beluga Whale (largest, famous for its song).

mnemonic.phrase: Ants March, Bees Buzz, Butterflies Flutter, Beetles Crawl, Praying Mantis Waits, Tarantulas Creep, Scorpions Sting.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Ants March → Ant (smallest); Bees Buzz → Bee; Butterflies Flutter → Butterfly; Beetles Crawl → Beetle; Praying Mantis Waits → Praying Mantis; Tarantulas Creep → Tarantula; Scorpions Sting → Scorpion (largest/most feared, ends the list).

mnemonic.phrase: Chicks Peep, Ducks Waddle, Rabbits Hop, Goats Butt, Sheep Baa, Pigs Oink, Cows Moo.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Chicks Peep → Chick (smallest); Ducks Waddle → Duck; Rabbits Hop → Rabbit; Goats Butt → Goat; Sheep Baa → Sheep; Pigs Oink → Pig; Cows Moo → Cow (largest common farm animal).

mnemonic.phrase: Sun Bears Bask, Sloth Bears Shuffle, Black Bears Forage, Giant Pandas Munch, Brown Bears Fish, Polar Bears Swim.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Sun Bears Bask → Sun Bear (smallest bear species); Sloth Bears Shuffle → Sloth Bear; Black Bears Forage → Black Bear; Giant Pandas Munch → Giant Panda; Brown Bears Fish → Brown Bear; Polar Bears Swim → Polar Bear (largest, ends the list).

mnemonic.phrase: Golden Frescoes, Draped Bronze, Blooming Venus, Lively Genius, Marble Might, Radiant Madonnas, Tinted Glory.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Golden Frescoes → Giotto (early frescoes); Draped Bronze → Donatello (bronze sculpture); Blooming Venus → Botticelli (Birth of Venus); Lively Genius → Leonardo da Vinci; Marble Might → Michelangelo; Radiant Madonnas → Raphael; Tinted Glory → Titian (master of color).

mnemonic.phrase: Candlelit Drama, Rich Flesh, Avenging Heroine, Baroque Marble, Velvet Court, Rembrandt's Shadows, Velvety Light.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Candlelit Drama → Caravaggio (dramatic chiaroscuro); Rich Flesh → Rubens; Avenging Heroine → Artemisia Gentileschi (Judith Slaying Holofernes); Baroque Marble → Bernini; Velvet Court → Velázquez; Rembrandt's Shadows → Rembrandt; Velvety Light → Vermeer (luminous interiors).

mnemonic.phrase: Modern Scandal, Dancers Twirl, Colorful Apples, Misty Waterlilies, Radiant Dancers, Mothers Watch, Charming Teatime.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Modern Scandal → Manet (Olympia caused scandal); Dancers Twirl → Degas; Colorful Apples → Cézanne (still lifes); Misty Waterlilies → Monet; Radiant Dancers → Renoir; Mothers Watch → Morisot (mother-and-child scenes); Charming Teatime → Cassatt (domestic scenes).

mnemonic.phrase: Reveries Bloom, Rousing Jungles, Golden Tahiti, Vivid Swirls, Sparkling Dots, Sister Dots, Theater Posters.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Reveries Bloom → Odilon Redon (dreamlike imagery); Rousing Jungles → Henri Rousseau (jungle scenes); Golden Tahiti → Paul Gauguin; Vivid Swirls → Van Gogh; Sparkling Dots → Seurat (pointillism); Sister Dots → Paul Signac (also pointillist); Theater Posters → Toulouse-Lautrec (Moulin Rouge posters).

mnemonic.phrase: Kaleidoscope Colors, Musical Cutouts, Mondrian's Grid, Kid-like Symbols, Picasso's Fractures, Braided Facets, Oversized Flowers.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Kaleidoscope Colors → Kandinsky (abstract color); Musical Cutouts → Matisse; Mondrian's Grid → Mondrian; Kid-like Symbols → Klee (whimsical, childlike forms); Picasso's Fractures → Picasso (cubist fracturing); Braided Facets → Braque (co-founder of cubism); Oversized Flowers → Georgia O'Keeffe.

mnemonic.phrase: Cryptic Plazas, Eerie Forests, Miró's Symbols, Mysterious Pipe, Dripping Clocks, Kahlo's Pain, Cryptic Beasts.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Cryptic Plazas → Giorgio de Chirico (empty piazzas); Eerie Forests → Max Ernst; Miró's Symbols → Joan Miró; Mysterious Pipe → René Magritte (This Is Not a Pipe); Dripping Clocks → Salvador Dalí (The Persistence of Memory); Kahlo's Pain → Frida Kahlo; Cryptic Beasts → Leonora Carrington (fantastical creatures).

mnemonic.phrase: Loud Comic-Panels, Warhol's Soup Cans, Kusama's Dots, Hockney's Pools, Sherman's Selfies, Haring's Figures, Basquiat's Crown.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Loud Comic-Panels → Roy Lichtenstein; Warhol's Soup Cans → Andy Warhol; Kusama's Dots → Yayoi Kusama; Hockney's Pools → David Hockney; Sherman's Selfies → Cindy Sherman (self-portraits); Haring's Figures → Keith Haring; Basquiat's Crown → Jean-Michel Basquiat (his crown motif).

mnemonic.phrase: Rodin's Thinker, Bronze Simplicity, Monumental Curves, Colorful Mobiles, Gaunt Figures, Boundless Spiders, Steel Curves.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Rodin's Thinker → Auguste Rodin; Bronze Simplicity → Constantin Brancusi (abstracted bronze forms); Monumental Curves → Henry Moore; Colorful Mobiles → Alexander Calder; Gaunt Figures → Alberto Giacometti (elongated bronze figures); Boundless Spiders → Louise Bourgeois (giant spider sculptures); Steel Curves → Richard Serra (monumental steel plates).

mnemonic.phrase: Mud-brick Ziggurats, Eternal Pyramids, Graceful Marble, Etruscan Tombs, Roman Arches, Byzantine Mosaics.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Mud-brick Ziggurats → Mesopotamian art (ziggurats, cuneiform); Eternal Pyramids → Egyptian art; Graceful Marble → Greek art (classical sculpture); Etruscan Tombs → Etruscan art (painted tomb chambers); Roman Arches → Roman art/architecture; Byzantine Mosaics → Byzantine art (gold mosaics).

mnemonic.phrase: Daguerre's Silver Plate, Talbot's Paper Prints, Stieglitz's Clouds, Adams' Mountains, Bourke-White's Factories, Cartier-Bresson's Moment, Arbus' Outsiders.
mnemonic.phoneticNotes: Daguerre's Silver Plate → Louis Daguerre (daguerreotype); Talbot's Paper Prints → William Henry Fox Talbot; Stieglitz's Clouds → Alfred Stieglitz; Adams' Mountains → Ansel Adams; Bourke-White's Factories → Margaret Bourke-White (industrial photography); Cartier-Bresson's Moment → Henri Cartier-Bresson ('decisive moment'); Arbus' Outsiders → Diane Arbus.

1.1: Kitchen ordering corrected to procedural food-lifecycle order (Refrigerator first); phrase updated to RCOSD.
Added phoneticNotes field to mnemonic objects where reinforcement is documented.
Added existing_acronym as a valid mnemonic type (used by HOMES).
orderingType values standardised: canonical_sequence | adapted_cultural | procedural | natural_ordering | generated_mnemonic.
orderingRule for Great Lakes clarified that the order is the mnemonic, not a geographic ordering.
1.2: Added 10 more Home-category rooms (Bathroom, Laundry Room, Entryway, Bedroom, Home Office, Living Room, Dining Room, Home Gym, Nursery, Garage), each with a procedural or natural_ordering furniture/fixture list and a generated_phrase mnemonic, matching Kitchen's existing style.
1.3: Added a new "Zoo" building category with 10 exhibits (Primates House, Raptor Aviary, Reptile House, Big Cats, African Savanna, Aquarium, Arctic Zone, Insect House, Petting Zoo, Bear Den), each ordered by natural_ordering (body size or habitat depth, smallest/shallowest to largest/deepest) with a generated_phrase mnemonic in the established house style.
1.4: Added an "Art Museum" building category with 10 galleries (Renaissance, Baroque, Impressionist, Post-Impressionist, Modern Art, Surrealism, Pop Art, Sculpture Garden, Antiquities, Photography), each a natural_ordering list (chronological by artist birth year, or civilizational era for Antiquities) with a generated_phrase mnemonic in the established house style.
